ceu: ✦ The trine between the Moon and Saturn at {H:1803817767000}

t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.

The trine between the Moon and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your horizons and your image: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
With Mercury retrograde in your friendship sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Say a prayer or set an intention for your path.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: Today is a day to let go of what weighs you down: a resentment, a habit, an old distrust.

The trine between the Moon and Saturn brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your inner life: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
With Mars retrograde in your home and family sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Take a deep breath whenever you feel jealousy or distrust.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: With the Moon in your house of partnerships, the balance between giving and receiving is at stake. Look for the middle ground.

The trine between the Moon and Saturn brings together, in your favour, relationships and friendships: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
With Mercury retrograde in your horizons sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Ask the person beside you how you can help.

t: The Moon asks for method and care with the details. A small adjustment to your routine makes a difference.

The trine between the Moon and Saturn brings together, in your favour, routine and your career: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Let things flow without forcing them.
With Mars retrograde in your money sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Get up from your chair every hour and stretch.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: A day to shine without fear. What you do with passion is contagious to those around you.

The trine between the Moon and Saturn brings together, in your favour, romance and your horizons: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
With Mercury retrograde in your relationships sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Show someone what you have created, without fear of criticism.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: The Moon passes through your area of home and family. It is a day to be close to those who give you roots.

The trine between the Moon and Saturn brings together, in your favour, family and intimacy: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
With Mars retrograde in your inner life sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Offer help to someone in your family without waiting to be asked.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: Today your mind is quicker and more curious. Use it to settle pending matters in writing or in person.

The trine between the Moon and Saturn brings together, in your favour, conversations and relationships: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
With Mercury retrograde in your romance sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Call a brother, sister, cousin or neighbour just to see how they are.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: With the Moon in your house of values, you crave comfort and concrete things. Choose with your head before you spend.

The trine between the Moon and Saturn brings together, in your favour, money and routine: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
With Mars retrograde in your career sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Tidy your wallet and your papers: order attracts clarity.

t: Today the Moon visits your sign and puts your energy in the spotlight. People notice you more, so show your best side.

The trine between the Moon and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your image and romance: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
With Mercury retrograde in your communication sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Say no to a request that takes you away from your priorities.

t: A day for prayer, meditation or a simple walk on your own. The peace you find today stays with you.

The trine between the Moon and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your inner life and family: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
With Mars retrograde in your intimacy sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Settle an old matter before starting something new.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: The Moon passes through your area of friends and projects. Good company gives you energy today.

The trine between the Moon and Saturn brings together, in your favour, friendships and conversations: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
With Mercury retrograde in your self-image sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Join a group or a conversation about a subject you enjoy.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: Today work and reputation carry emotional weight. Praise or criticism touches you more than usual.

The trine between the Moon and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your career and money: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. An idea from today could become a real project.
With Mars retrograde in your daily routine sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Show your work: people who do not show up are not remembered.
